description: Would this simple strategy have made money over the last year? Replays it on Binance 4h candles with Dolphin's live rule engine, PancakeSwap fees and BNB Chain gas included, on a sample $100, and compares it with just holding the coin. The same test as dolphinamp.xyz/test. entry: dip = buy after the price falls `level`% in a day; rsi = buy when RSI(14) drops below `level`; trend = buy RSI below `level` while price is above its 100 EMA; momentum = buy after a `level`% rise in a day. Give a target and/or a stop (% from the entry).
name: test_strategy
title: Test a trading strategy on a year of real prices
